theorem bbolt.open_lock [HasExt osFsExt] (B : bbolt.BNs) (N : Namespace) (γs : GName) (D :
    bbolt.Data) (dp db : Loc) : bbolt.dpProt N γs B.bq dp db ∗ ghostVar γs (Qp.half 1) 0 ∗
    bbolt.boltState { gs := bbolt.mkGs B, ns := N } 1 D ⊢ ghostVar B.st (Qp.half 1) D ∗ |={⊤}[⊤ \
    ↑(bbolt.dpN N)]▷=> ghostVar γs (Qp.half 1) 1 ∗ typedPointsto dp db (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1))

theorem bbolt.open_unlock [HasExt osFsExt] (B : bbolt.BNs) (N : Namespace) (γs : GName) (D :
    bbolt.Data) (dp db : Loc) : bbolt.dpProt N γs B.bq dp db ∗ ghostVar γs (Qp.half 1) 1 ∗
    typedPointsto dp db (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ghostVar B.st (Qp.half 1) D ⊢ |={⊤}=> typedPointsto dp db
    DFrac.discard ∗ bbolt.boltState { gs := bbolt.mkGs B, ns := N } 1 D
